title: Exchange an SDS-plus chisel and secure its ball lock
instruction: Replace the used point chisel with the flat chisel. Put the used chisel in its tray, secure the replacement in the unpowered holder, and leave both hands clear.
context: Construction laborers operate drills and jackhammers as core work; BLS reports1,489,300 US workers in2025. This inert authored fixture preserves manufacturer-documented tool exchange, automatic retention and sleeve release.
setup: Standard two-arm YAM station/table z0.7475m. Fixed original holder mouth(0.37,0,0.86)m, insertion axis+X; visible clamped inert case. Spring-return sleeve travels8mm; one free7mm steel ball remains in a physical guide/port. Used point chisel starts retained40mm into the holder; flat replacement starts in a V cradle at(0.37,0.30,0.7725)m, rolled45deg. Both original blunt test chisels are200mm long with authored10mm shanks, separate open drive grooves/closed ball grooves and12mm main stems. Empty240x80mm used-part tray centered(0.27,-0.30,0.7495)m. Seven physical bodies/6original USD assets; masses3kg holder,40.63g sleeve,1.41g ball,153.84/161.37g chisels and450g each tray/cradle. All solids, materials, COM/inertias and numerical provenance in scene.json/PARAMETERS.md. No live drill, power connection, dust, concrete or cutting operation. Physical clear side inserts expose the ball; the load-bearing roof remains steel.
scoring: Current-state credit:0.25 when every used-chisel collider clears the holder interface bounding region by5mm;0.5 when all lie within its tray.0.75 additionally requires replacement axial depth31–45.2mm, centered within0.35mm/aligned within0.02rad, closed-slot ball capture and sleeve retraction<=0.35mm;180deg groove symmetry/axial play allowed. Full score requires2s pairwise witness drift<=0.5mm and all robot links20mm clear. Lost parts, escaped ball, disconnected sleeve, moved fixture, exceeded stops, malformed state or penetration>0.20mm permanently invalidate. See MEASUREMENT.md for numeric capture boundaries.
run_limit: 3,200 control actions at20Hz (160 simulated seconds). Complete ideal controller1639actions/81.95s; native timing not run.
reset_notes: Seed0/no pose jitter. Restore every free root and sleeve coordinate, zero all velocities, independent spring rest target-1mm, and clear every scorer/controller/trace history. Native fresh resets required.
fidelity: Original inert authored fixture, not OEM dimensional compatibility. Manufacturer documents7mm ball and exchange sequence; hidden race/locking land, inspection inserts, slot profiles, masses, friction and spring are authored. Free exact sphere, real groove/key/cage/cam contacts and passive axial play; no virtual attachment or collision switching. No cutting, hammering, motor, grease flow, measured hardware or native success claimed.
scores: Native expert and Dream-1 not run. Supplemental CPU force fixtures/ideal grasps are not robot demonstrations.
